devdoc.details: Every writer verifies the executor's V2 per-call transition context.      There is no direct-authority or selector-only authorization fallback.

isModuleEligible(address,bytes32,bytes4).notice: Returns true when `module` is `ACTIVE`, matches the expected         module type and interface ID, and its live codehash still         matches the registered runtime code hash.

moduleRecord(address).notice: Returns the stored record for `module` (zero record when unknown).

moduleRegistryManifest().notice: Returns the registry's own manifest commitment.

registerModule((address,bytes32,bytes32,.notice: Registers a new module through an exact class-1 V2 transition.

setModuleRegistryManifest(bytes32,string.notice: Updates the registry manifest through an exact class-1 V2         transition.

setModuleStatus(address,uint8,bytes32,st.notice: Changes status through an exact class-0 tightening or class-1         loosening V2 transition.
